evidence_for: Context location: H4 context (current) is bull-trend/breakout-spike with always_in long; H4 bar 115 spiked 2658.06-2850.00 above the 2700.00 double top (H4 bars 103/113) and H4 bars 116-118 followed through to 2804.59; D1 context (current) is bull-trend with a breakout above its 73-bar range top 1974.46.

Pullback held the breakout point: H1 bar 105 (open_time 1790020800000) high 2804.59 pulled back to the H1 bar 114 (open_time 1790053200000) low 2716.01, i.e. ~88.58 points and still above the 2700.00 H4 breakout level; the raw H1 bars show no close back below 2700.00.

Bull reversal at the pullback low: M15 bar_index 98 (open_time 1790055000000) is a bull bar open 2718.44 / low 2716.01 / high 2732.61 / close 2732.61, closing at its high, and M15 lows since then have risen (bar 110 low 2722.76; bar 118 low 2736.00), a higher-low sequence off 2716.01.

Recovery highs are being made with closes near highs: H1 bars 117-118 (open_time 1790064000000, 1790067600000) closed 2748.73 and 2749.09 versus highs 2748.84 and 2752.61, so the pullback is turning up rather than merely drifting.

The pending stop is only ~10.03 above the frozen close 2742.58 and breaks the pullback range top while price stays above the 2700.00 breakout level, so the 2716.01 pullback low is a defined structural invalidation.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: the last three M15 bars (indices 117-119: closes 2738.99, 2740.61, 2742.58) are small dojis inside a tight ~14-point range 2736.00-2752.61, so the pending trigger has no printed strong signal bar and the entry is a mid-pullback breakout (M15 range midpoint) rather than at an extreme.

H1 bar 119 (open_time 1790071200000) is a bear bar, open 2749.08 / high 2749.88 / low 2736.00 / close 2742.58, closing in the lower half just under its high, and H4 context flags bars 119-120 closing 2738.87/2724.95 near lows with the last H4 close below H4 bar 115's midpoint 2754.03, so acceptance of the 2700.00 breakout is not yet demonstrated.

Both D1 and H4 contexts list climax risk: D1's final 208.30-point bar (close 2775.61 after a 2850.00 probe) and the H4 single-bar spike 2658.06-2850.00 can be read as exhaustion, and H4 bars 119-120 already pulled back ~46% of bar 115's range.
Overhead 2804.59 (H1 bar 105 high) sits ~52 points above the trigger while a stop would sit at 2716.01 (~36.61 risk), so nearby opposing structure crowds the first reward objective.
uncertainty: The trigger above 2752.61 is pending and untriggered; the 2736.00-2752.61 M15 tight range can resolve downward first.
H4 acceptance of the 2700.00 breakout is unresolved: H4 bars 119-120 closed near their lows (2738.87, 2724.95) and the last H4 close is below H4 bar 115's midpoint 2754.03.
If the next M15 bars overlap in the 2736-2752 middle again, the pullback is a trading range at this location rather than a flag, degrading the setup.

An M15 close back below 2700.00 (the H4 double-top breakout level) would mark the breakout as failed and return the read toward the 2658.06-2700.00 consolidation.
An M15 bull bar closing above 2752.61 with follow-through above 2804.59 would confirm the breakout-pullback continuation and strengthen the bull-trend/breakout-spike read.

setup.type: no_setup_mid_range_tight_cluster

evidence_for: M15 indices 112-119 (open times 1790071200000-1790077500000) are a tight 8-bar cluster with heavy overlap inside 2735.85 (index 116 low) to 2749.88 (index 112 high); the last bar (index 119: open 2745.61, high 2745.74, low 2736.97, close 2740.2) is a bear bar closing below its 2741.36 midpoint and under index 118's low 2738.24, so no bull signal bar and no range breakout is present.

M15 location is mid-range, not an edge: the post-spike advance from 2702.56 (index 14 low) to 2804.59 (index 57 high) was retraced about 88.58 points (~87%) to 2716.01 (index 94 low), leaving 2740.2 roughly 37% up that 2702.56-2804.59 range.

Buy-climax risk rather than trend momentum: M15 index 14 (open 2708.33, high 2850, low 2702.56, close 2739.13) spanned 147.44 points but closed in its bottom quarter, leaving a 110.87-point upper tail; the same hour on H4 (index 113: high 2850, close 2723.15) also closed below its own 2754.03 midpoint.

H1 shows a stalled bounce: H1 bars opening 1790064000000 and 1790067600000 closed 2748.73 and 2749.09 (high 2752.61), then H1 bars opening 1790071200000 and 1790074800000 closed 2742.58 and 2740.2 with the last low 2735.85; the pullback low since the H1 index 104 high 2804.59 is 2716.01 (H1 index 113 low).

Overhead supply crowds any long taken here: M15 highs 2743.54-2752.61 (indices 111-118) sit only 3-13 points above 2740.2, while a structural invalidation is 24 points away (index 94 low 2716.01), a poor shape for a mid-range entry.
evidence_against: The strongest counterargument: the higher-timeframe raw bars are bullish, not just labels - H4 indices 101 and 111 both printed exact 2700 highs and H4 index 113 (open 2658.81) broke that double top with a 2850 spike, followed by H4 closes 2754.31 and 2775.61 (indices 115-116); the pullback has held above 2700 and higher lows off H4 index 79 low 2358.62 remain intact.

An actionable long existed at the decision: a buy stop above M15 index 118 high 2745.79 (or above index 111 high 2752.61) with invalidation at the M15 pullback low 2716.01 (index 94) is a breakout-pullback continuation in that bull trend, and the 8-bar tight cluster can break upward; nothing in the closed bars has invalidated it.
uncertainty: Whether 2700-2850 is an accepted H4 breakout or a one-bar blow-off cannot be settled from closed bars; the 2850 print on M15 index 14 may be a single-bar liquidation wick rather than traded supply.
The operative range low is ambiguous (M15 index 94 low 2716.01 versus index 14 low 2702.56), which changes how much room a long would have before its structural invalidation.

The final H4 bar (open 2724.95, high 2752.61, close 2740.2) looks bullish on the H4 grid, but its strength came from its first two H1 bars (closes 2748.73, 2749.09) that were then given back (2742.58, 2740.2), so H4-level signals lag the raw M15 balance.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2752.61 (index 111 high) that holds, followed by a close above 2804.59 (index 57 high), would mark accepted breakout follow-through and support a breakout-pullback long.
An M15 close below 2716.01 (index 94 low), and especially below 2702.56 (index 14 low), would defeat the H4 breakout above the 2700 double top and shift the read to failed breakout / trading range.

A fresh pullback into 2700-2716.01 that prints a bull reversal bar closing near its high (as index 94 did: open 2718.44, high 2732.61, close 2732.61) would create the low-risk long location inside the bull context.

evidence_for: M15 is a range, not a directional leg: since the 2850.00 spike (index 10, open_time 1789983000000) the last ~105 bars overlap between 2709.56 (index 15 low, open_time 1789987500000) and 2804.59 (index 53 high, open_time 1790021700000), and the last close 2755.14 (index 119, open_time 1790081100000) is ~1.9 points from that 2757.08 midpoint - mid-range, where Brooks gives no edge either way.

A long entered at 2755.14 runs immediately into resistance 16-49 points overhead: 2771.45 (index 52 high, open_time 1790020800000), 2776.90 (index 60 high), 2785.48 (index 64 high), 2804.59 (index 53 high); opposing structure crowds the setup relative to any structural invalidation (2716.01 is 39 points away).

The apparent trigger is marginal: the last bar (index 119) ranges only 2747.86-2755.14 = 7.28 points and exceeds the prior flag high 2752.61 (index 107 high, open_time 1790070300000) by just 2.53 points, a small bar relative to the surrounding M15 bars.

The 2850.00 spike bar (index 10) closed 2739.13, i.e. 110.87 below its high, leaving an unresolved buy-climax tail that has been retraced ~48% (2850.00 to 2716.01, index 90 low, open_time 1790055000000); a fresh long would need acceptance above 2804.59, not a mid-range probe.
evidence_against: Strongest bull case: D1 is bull-trend/breakout-spike with the last D1 bar closing 2775.61 above the 2771 spike high, and H4 is bull-trend with breakout_mode true, holding above the 2700.00 breakout level with rising swing lows 2358.62, 2435.71, 2486.12, 2568.16, 2646.02, 2716.01.

The M15 pullback is printing higher lows (2722.76 index 102; 2736.97 index 115; 2747.86 index 119) and the last bar is a bull bar closing at its high 2755.14 (M15 index 119; same bar as H1 index 119), which is a legitimate Brooks buy signal above the flag with a stop under 2747.86 or 2735.85.
Price has held above the 2700.00 H4 breakout level and the 2716.01 pullback low for ~30 M15 bars, so bears have not yet reclaimed the prior structure.
uncertainty: H4/D1 contexts are labeled current but were stamped before the M15 slide to 2716.01 (index 90, open_time 1790055000000); their bull labels do not yet price that probe.
The M15 range has not resolved: 2755.14 is neither a range-edge buy (2716.01-2736.97) nor acceptance above 2804.59, so the state is unresolved rather than failed.
Whether the 7.28-point last bar starts a flag breakout or is a final probe into range resistance cannot be settled from the supplied bars alone.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A strong M15 close above 2804.59 (index 53 high) with follow-through would make a breakout long valid at acceptance above the range top.
A pullback into 2721.79-2736.97 (index 98 low / index 115 low) that prints a bull reversal bar would offer a long at the range low, a favorable location.
Consecutive M15 closes below 2716.01 (index 90 low) and then 2700.00 would break the last higher low and shift the read to a failed breakout / range-down.

Whether 2786.81 (M15 index 113) / 2785.29 (index 114) is a lower high beneath the H4 2804.59 boundary or will be exceeded on the next intraday leg.

setup.type: range-low test inside M15/H4 trading range; bear microchannel stalling at support

A short here sells support inside a range; a long here has no bull signal bar.

The last four M15 bars are a shrinking doji cluster, not a breakout: bar 116 range 7.96 (2727.77-2719.81), bar 117 range 10.84 (2725.72-2714.88), bar 118 range 5.05 (2726.10-2721.05), bar 119 range 4.39 (2722.14-2717.75, close 2719.63). Tight small-range bars at support are breakout mode, so no directional edge is available yet.

The immediate bear leg is an extended microchannel: 18 lower highs from 2748.23 (bar 101) to 2722.14 (bar 119) with no pullback bar, so a short has no low-risk entry with a nearby invalidation, and the same structure offers a long no reversal bar to buy.

Higher-timeframe structure opposes a short at this level: D1 is bull-trend/breakout-spike with higher lows (2357.18, 2358.62, 2568.16-class structure) and H4 retains a higher low at 2568.16 with no close below 2716.01, so a bear break of the range low is a counter-trend break.

No break has occurred at the frozen time: H1 bar 119 (open 2726.71, high 2727.77, low 2714.88, close 2719.63) and M15 bar 119 (open 2721.31, close 2719.63) both closed above the 2716.01/2714.88 support band, so any short is anticipatory against a level that has held twice (M15 2717.02 at bar 114 and 2714.88 at bar 117).
evidence_against: Strongest case for a short: a pending stop below 2714.88 (M15 bar 117 low) has a defined invalidation above 2727.77 (bars 115/116 highs) and would be the bear breakout of the H4 2716.01 range low, with the H4 2568.16 higher low as the next structure - a Brooks breakout in the direction of the immediate microchannel, and momentum backs it with strong bear bars at M15 98 (open 2749.80 close 2738.25), 103 (open 2741.90 close 2733.85), 113 (open 2731.30 close 2720.51) and 114 (open 2720.81 close 2718.06), plus H4 directional_pressure 'bear' and two H4 bear bars closing near their lows.

Strongest case for a long: the D1 bull trend, the H4 unbroken higher low, and a double-tested support at 2716.01/2714.88 mean a failed bear break could reverse up toward 2748.23/2786.81; Brooks would buy a bull reversal bar or second entry at a range low in a bull trend rather than sell it.
uncertainty: The 2714.88/2716.01 support band has not broken, so the resolution of the doji cluster (bear breakout vs range-low reversal) is unknowable from closed bars.

conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close below 2714.88 with a following bar closing below it would confirm the H4 range-low break and make a bear breakout/continuation short valid.

A close back above 2748.23 returns price to the middle of the M15 range and keeps the no-trade read; a close above 2786.81 resumes the bull trend.
An H4 close below 2568.16, or an H4 close above 2804.59, would change the larger regime and the location assessment of this support.

market_context.htf_read: H1/H4/D1 are bull-trend with always_in long, but the last closed H4 bar (open_time 1790164800000, open 2726.71, high 2727.77, low 2648.49, close 2659.00) is a large bear bar closing near its low that broke below the twelve-bar 2716.01-2804.59 tight range and below the 2658.06 low of the 2850.00 buy-climax spike bar; the H4 context labels it a possible buy climax plus final flag with no follow-through yet, i.e. a bear breakout from the top of a bull climax.
market_context.m15_read: M15 is a bear leg off that breakdown: lower highs 2681.07 (bar 108), 2668.59 (bar 106), 2668.02 (bar 119) and lower lows 2648.49 (bar 105) then 2641.37 (bar 112), followed by a four-bar tight trading range 2649.16-2668.02 (bars 116-119); last close 2665.44 sits at the top of that flag range.

setup.type: bear flag / tight-trading-range breakdown (breakout pullback after the H4 final-flag bear breakout)

trigger.reference: M15 bar 117 low 2649.16 - base of the four-bar flag range and lower low of the 2649.67/2649.16 double bottom; pending sell-stop below it

invalidation.reference: M15 bar 119 high 2668.02 - top of the four-bar flag range; a trade back above it voids the flag breakdown

evidence_for: H4 final-flag breakdown (current context, verified against the H1 raw bars): H4 bar open_time 1790164800000 (open 2726.71, high 2727.77, low 2648.49, close 2659.00) closes near its low after breaking the twelve-bar 2716.01-2804.59 tight range and the 2658.06 spike-bar low that followed the 2850.00 buy climax; the M15 range below it is the first pullback of that breakout, and the M15 flag is the entry structure.

M15 structure is a bear leg, so the tight range is a bear flag rather than a bull flag: lower highs 2681.07 (bar 108 high), 2668.59 (bar 106 high), 2668.02 (bar 119 high) with a lower low at 2641.37 (bar 112 low) versus the earlier 2648.49 low (bar 105 low).

The M15 flag is tight and well defined: bars 116-119 (open_times 1790182800000-1790185500000) hold inside 2649.16-2668.02 with small ranges (bar 116 range 12.20, bar 118 range 7.14, bar 119 range 4.00); the pending stop at 2649.16 breaks the 2649.67 (bar 116 low) / 2649.16 (bar 117 low) double bottom that forms the flag floor.

Risk is structurally bounded and not chased: trigger 2649.16 against invalidation 2668.02 (bar 119 high) is a 18.86-point structural risk taken at the flag floor rather than in the middle of the down move that already ran 2722.14 (bar 104 high) to 2641.37 (bar 112 low).
evidence_against: Counter to the higher timeframes: D1 (current context) is bull-trend/breakout-spike with always_in long and H4 keeps always_in long; last close 2665.44 is still far above the last H4/D1 higher low 2568.16, so the entry is countertrend until the H4 break is confirmed.

M15 micro-momentum is up, not down: bars 117, 118, 119 are three consecutive bull bars with higher lows (2649.16, 2657.51, 2664.02) closing near their highs (2665.44 versus bar 119 high 2668.02), and price has climbed back above the H4 spike-bar low 2658.06 after trading 2641.37 - the failed-break / bear-trap case the H4 context itself names.

The immediate trader's equation is thin: the nearest opposing structure, the 2641.37 spike low (bar 112 low), is only about 7.8 points below the trigger while the structural stop is 18.86 points above it, so the trade needs a full H4-scale second leg rather than the first 20 points to pay.

No H4 follow-through exists in the closed bars: the two H1 bars after the breakout bar (open_time 1790179200000, open 2658.15, low 2641.37, close 2659.73; open_time 1790182800000, open 2659.73, close 2665.44) both closed higher, so the H4 breakout is still unconfirmed at the decision time.
uncertainty: Whether the H4 break below 2716.01/2658.06 is a final-flag reversal or a first-break bear trap inside a D1 bull trend cannot be settled from closed bars available at the decision time; the confirming follow-through bar is not yet printed.

The flag is only 18.86 points tall with tiny bars (bar 119 range 4.00), so its exact floor is noise-sensitive and the pending stop at 2649.16 could be filled by a brief probe rather than a real breakdown.
Volume is treated as secondary context only and no order-flow/DOM data is used; the read rests on OHLC and swing structure.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A close back above 2668.02 (M15 bar 119 high) without the stop triggering keeps the flag intact and strengthens the bear-trap case; a close above 2681.07-2716.01 restores the H4 range read and favors the long side.
A decisive break below 2641.37 (M15 bar 112 low) with bars closing near their lows confirms the flag breakdown and shifts the H4 read toward a full two-legged correction to 2568.16.
If the stop fills at 2649.16 but the next M15 bar closes back above 2668.02, treat the bear flag as failed rather than managing the position.
Sustained trading back inside 2716.01-2804.59 would make the current leg a bear leg inside the H4 range and void the short thesis.

market_context.context_alignment: D1 Always-In long (phase breakout-spike) vs H4 Always-In long but with the last H4 bar closing near its low below the 2716.01 nine-bar range base and the 2658.06 spike-bar low; the structural contexts disagree, so neither direction has aligned context support at the frozen time.

evidence_for: M15 (bar 104, open_time 1790175600000, high 2681.07) and M15 (bar 108, open_time 1790179200000, low 2641.37) bound a ~40-point tight range; the last ten M15 bars (110-119) overlap heavily inside that band, and the M15 bar 119 close 2668.20 (open 2661.78, high 2672.55, low 2661.23) sits just above the 2661.22 midpoint and 13.35 points below the 2681.07 range high, i.e. in the middle of the structure rather than at an edge where Brooks entries are located.

The decision bar itself is not an actionable signal: M15 bar 119 is a small bull bar with a ~4.35-point upper tail that fails to reach the 2681.07 swing high, and there is no bear signal bar (no bar closing near its low) to sell below either; trigger_status is absent in both directions.

Counter-direction structural disagreement: H4's last bar (open_time 1790164800000, open 2726.71, high 2727.77, low 2648.49, close 2659.00) closed near its low below the 2716.01 nine-bar range base and just under the 2658.06 spike-bar low (fresh bear breakout attempt with no follow-through bar), while D1 context is a bull trend (Always-In long, phase breakout-spike) with the last D1 close 2752.43 and a stall bar at its window high - so a long fights the fresh H4 bear breakout and a short fights D1/H4 Always-In long.

Reward/risk on the only two conceivable triggers is unfavorable: a buy stop above M15 bar 119 high 2672.55 risks to 2648.49 (M15 bar 101 low) for ~19.7 points against ~8.5 points to first resistance 2681.07, and a sell below the range would need price back under 2641.37 where the next support is the already-tested 2648.49/2641.37 shelf.
evidence_against: Bull case: M15 may be completing a double bottom at 2648.49 (bar 101 low) and 2641.37 (bar 108 low), with three consecutive higher H1 closes (H1 bars 117-119: 2659.73, 2665.44, 2668.20) and D1 plus H4 Always-In long; a buy stop above M15 bar 119 high 2672.55 with invalidation under 2641.37 is a defensible continuation-pullback entry if the 2681.07 lower high is cleared first.

Bear case: the H4 breakout bar (close 2659.00 near its low, below 2716.01 and marginally below 2658.06) plus the M15 lower-high sequence 2727.77 (bar 92 high) -> 2722.14 (bar 100 high) -> 2681.07 (bar 104 high) -> 2672.55 (bar 119 high) supports selling the bear-flag rally up to 2681.07 with invalidation above that swing high.

evidence_for: M15 bar 1790235900000 (o 2694.20 h 2698.06 l 2691.92 c 2692.23) makes only a 0.65 new high over 2697.41 (bar 1790226000000 high) and closes in the lower half of its own 6.14 range: no strong bull breakout bar with follow-through.

Location is the top of the 2641.37-2698.06 M15 range; H4/H1 resistance 2722.14 (H1 bar 1790172000000 high) and 2727.77 (H4 read high) sit 24-35 points above, so a long at 2692-2698 chases into resistance while a nearby invalidation (2679.09) gives roughly a 1:1 trader's equation.

H4 raw read shows lower highs 2850.00 (bar 1789977600000 high) -> 2804.59 (bar 1790020800000 high) -> 2786.81 (bar 1790121600000 high) and a pullback that retraced ~74% of the 2568.16-2850.00 push: deep pullback/range, not pre-breakout compression (H4 four-bar pause 2641.37-2727.77 only).

The recovery from 2641.37 is ~20 overlapping M15 bars with small bodies and mid-range closes (e.g. 1790210700000 o 2684.60 c 2681.47; 1790222400000 o 2675.47 c 2671.19), i.e. trading-range behavior at the range top rather than a bull channel.
D1 context: final D1 bar 1790121600000 closed 2684.16, ~29% of its range, back below the 2680-2700 breakout area, so acceptance above the 27-bar range (2357.18-2680) is not yet shown.

evidence_against: D1 bull-trend channel with higher low 2358.62 and a breakout above the 27-bar 2357.18-2680 range to 2850.00; the pullback is only ~42% of the 2358.62-2850.00 leg and held far above 2357.18, so the bull context is intact.

evidence_for: Location: M15 zero-index 119 (open_time 1790239500000) closed 2667.89 versus the operative M15/H1 range low 2641.37 (zero-index 53, open_time 1790179200000) and high 2698.06 (zero-index 115, open_time 1790235900000); midpoint 2669.72, so the decision price is the middle of a ~57-point, ~60-bar tight trading range, where the method says stand aside.

Timeframes conflict rather than align: the current D1 and H4 contexts read bull-trend yet both describe price back inside ranges at the highs (D1 last close 2684.16 under the 2680-2700 top; H4 14-bar range 2641.37-2804.59 with the 2716.01 flag floor broken at 1790164800000 and not reclaimed), while the final M15 and H1 bars are two-sided chop that already delivered its move.
evidence_against: Bull continuation case: the supplied H4/D1 contexts (current) describe a bull regime with rising H4 lows 2358.62, 2436.87, 2568.16, 2641.37, and M15 lows stepped up from 2641.37 (zero-index 53) to 2649.16 (1790183700000) to 2658.43 (1790188200000) to 2666.2 (1790215200000); a long stop above 2674.78 (zero-index 118 high) with invalidation under 2641.37 buys a pullback low inside an HTF bull trend.

Both cases require entering at the same mid-range price after the spike, which is the core reason the current bars do not support an entry.
The final M15 bar's 5.9-point lower tail and upper-quartile close show buyers responding at 2662, so a short at this instant also lacks signal-bar quality.
uncertainty: H4 and D1 statements are taken from the supplied contexts (tagged current) rather than raw reads; raw M15/H1 OHLC governs, and no raw H4 read was required because no entry is taken.
The 2698.06 high beats the prior 2695.84 high by only 2.22 points, so 'failed breakout at resistance' and 'routine range-top test' are not cleanly separable from closed bars alone.
The last two M15 bars are inside bars of each other's range, leaving immediate direction unresolved at the freeze.
conditions_that_change_market_read: Two M15 closes below 2641.37 end the range and make the H4 swing low 2568.16 the next reference, converting this into a breakout-short situation rather than a mid-range entry.
A close above 2698.06 (zero-index 115 high) with follow-through signals acceptance above the M15 range and aligns with the D1/H4 bull-trend contexts.
A bull reversal bar closing in the upper third within the 2641-2658 zone would create a range-low long with a clean invalidation under 2641.37.
Continued small overlapping bars between roughly 2662 and 2688 keep the read a tight trading range and keep both directions unattractive.

setup.type: bear breakout below the 18-hour M15 range 2641.37-2698.06, second leg down after the failed rally to 2698.06 and the un-reclaimed H4 flag-floor break at 2716.01

setup.type: bull breakout of a tight 10-bar M15 range (2633.31-2651.66) at the end of a bull-flag pullback; pending stop above the signal-bar high, structural stop below the range low

trigger.reference: M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790257500000) high - bull breakout bar closing at its high

invalidation.reference: M15 bar 106 (open_time 1790245800000) low - pullback low and tight-range low; losing it ends the bull breakout and reopens the leg toward 2568.16

evidence_for: M15 bars 116-119 (open_time 1790254800000 through 1790257500000) are four consecutive bull closes 2655.53, 2659.96, 2664.46, 2668.42, each in the upper part of its range; bar 119 (open 2664.47, high 2668.42, low 2660.03, close 2668.42) closed at its high, breaking the 10-bar tight range bounded by 2633.31 (bar 106 low) and 2651.66 (bar 113 high) with follow-through.

M15 bar 106 (open 2638.94, low 2633.31, high 2642.6, close 2642.59) is a bull reversal bar closing at its high, and that low is ~65 points above the H4 last major higher low 2568.16, so the bull-trend structure is intact.

Both supplied higher-timeframe contexts are current and read always_in long with primary_regime bull-trend; H4 measures the 2850.00-2633.31 pullback at ~45% of the 2370.54-2850 leg and D1 at ~42% of 2358.62-2850, i.e. normal bull-flag depths rather than a trend break.

Location is crowded: the trigger 2668.42 sits under the high 2670.98 of the strong H1 bear bar 115 (open 2667.89, close 2640.99) and M15 bar 118 already stalled at 2671.94, with 2676.56/2681.21/2695.84/2698.06 only 8-30 points above versus about 35 points to the structural invalidation at 2633.31.

The M15 bull leg spans only ~21 points (bar 116 low 2647.53 to 2668.42) while the preceding M15 bear leg from 2698.06 (bar 95) to 2633.31 (bar 106) spans ~65 points, so the bounce is equally consistent with a bear flag inside the H1 range.

H4 context flags a local bearish change of character (bar 1790164800000 closed 2659.00 below the 2716.01-2727.77 floor, bounce only to 2698.06) and an untested MTR-like risk toward 2568.16, while D1 shows no acceptance above 2680 (breakout_mode false).

Immediate overhead supply is only a few points away: 2694.37 (index 101 high, open_time 1790259300000), 2697.65 (index 110 high) and the 2698.06 H4/M15 shelf high, while the structural higher low that would define invalidation is 2660.49 (index 116 low, open_time 1790272800000), about 28 points below — the nearby opposing structure crowds the setup.

The last bull bars are small and not decisive: index 119 is O 2685.81 H 2692.07 L 2684.63 C 2689.04, a 7.44 range with a 3.03 upper tail and a close at ~59% of the bar, i.e. no strong bull signal bar at resistance after three up bars.

evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: D1 and H4 are still bull-trend with the higher-low structure intact (H4 low 2633.31 above 2569.80), M15 bars 116-119 are three consecutive bull bars with higher lows off 2660.49, and the H4 final bar is a bull reversal bar (O 2647.90 H 2694.37 L 2640.00 C 2682.25) rejecting 2633.31 — a pending stop above 2692.07 or 2698.06 is a legitimate breakout-pullback long candidate that has not yet failed.

timeframes.D1: bull-trend/channel, Always-In long; broke the 2357.18-2680 27-bar range to 2850 and pulled back to 2641.37 (newest closed bar 1790121600000 close 2684.16, near its low).
timeframes.H4: bull-trend in range phase; post-spike range 2633.31-2804.59, lower highs 2804.59/2786.81/2699.39, ~60% retracement of 2486.12-2850, price below the ~2719 midpoint; last two bars are bull closes in the upper third (1790251200000 close 2682.25, 1790265600000 open 2682.25/high 2699.39/close 2694.09).
timeframes.H1: two-sided; bull bars 116 (1790272800000) and 117 (1790276400000) close near their highs, two-bar pullback 118-119 holds above 2681.88.
timeframes.M15: tight 8-bar range 2682.01-2695.78 (bars 112-119) below the 2699.39 leg high; rising lows since 2633.31.

setup.type: tight-range / bull-flag breakout above the 2699.39 range high after the pullback held the 2680-2684 breakout zone

trigger.reference: M15 bar 111 high 2699.39 (1790279100000-1790279999999) - the leg high, the 9-hour range top, and the H4 level named for bull resumption; buy-stop above it

invalidation.reference: M15 bar 113 low 2682.01 (1790280900000-1790281799999) - lowest low of the 8-bar tight range; a trade through it breaks the flag and negates the breakout attempt

evidence_for: M15 higher lows since bar 75 low 2633.31 (1790245800000): bar 88 low 2655.22, bar 104 low 2660.49, bar 113 low 2682.01, bars 115-116 low 2684.58, against flat highs 2694.37/2694.84/2699.39 (bars 85/93/111) - a rising floor under a flat top.

M15 bars 112-119 (1790280000000-1790286300000) hold a tight 8-bar range 2682.01-2695.78 with shrinking activity (bar 119 volume 343527), i.e. no selling pressure at the top of the leg; a stop above 2699.39 breaks the range top and the H4 lower-high sequence in one move.

H1 bull legs close near their highs: bar 116 (1790272800000, open 2668.13, low 2660.49, close 2689.04) closes ~90% up its 31.58 range, bar 117 (high 2699.39, close 2694.09) ~70% up; the pullback bars 118-119 hold above 2681.88/2684.58.
H4 context (fresh) keeps bull-trend as the primary regime: pullback low 2633.31 holds far above the prior higher low 2486.12, and the last two H4 bars are bull closes in the upper third.

D1 context (fresh) is bull-trend with Always-In long: a break above the 2357.18-2680 range to 2850 with only a ~42% retracement to 2641.37, so current 2684-2699 is a test of the breakout zone rather than a structure break.
evidence_against: H4 has made lower highs and lower lows since 2850 (highs 2804.59, 2786.81, 2699.39; lows 2716.01, 2633.31) and 2633.31 undercut the spike bar low 2658.06, so the overlapping M15 advance (+66 points in ~10 hours) can equally be read as a bear flag retracing only ~30% of the 2850-2633.31 decline.

H4 phase is 'range' with a slightly negative 20-bar drift (close 2723.15 to 2694.09) and price below the ~2719 midpoint of 2633.31-2804.59, so this is a breakout attempt from the lower-middle of a larger range; the same window already produced a failed spike (H4 bar 1789128000000 tagged 2680, closed 2555.52, fully retraced).

D1's newest closed bar 1790121600000 closed 2684.16 near the low of its range and back below the 2680 range top, and current price 2684.97 is essentially at that close - no D1 follow-through for the breakout yet.
Immediate M15 momentum is not up: the last five highs (2689.02, 2689.16, 2689.07, 2688.99, 2691.52) sit below 2699.39, and bar 119 closes at its low (close 2684.97 vs low 2684.94).

Overhead congestion in the H1 2724-2782 band (bars 1790010000000-1790114399999) starts ~25 points above the trigger, so reward before the next supply area is limited relative to the ~17-point risk to 2682.01.
uncertainty: The 8-bar 2682.01-2695.78 tight range is ambiguous: a bull flag for the H1/H4 bull regime, or the apex of a bear flag inside the H4 leg down from 2850.
The pending stop above 2699.39 is unfilled; whether it triggers and then holds above 2700 (H4 transition condition) is unknown at this frozen bar.
Price is above the M15 range top but in the lower half of the H4 2633.31-2804.59 range, so the H4 range can keep rotating two-sided and stop the trade before a sustained continuation.
A deeper structural stop below the last higher low 2660.49 (M15 bar 104) also exists; it would widen risk to ~39 points, so the tight flag low 2682.01 was chosen instead.
conditions_that_change_market_read: Bull confirmation: consecutive M15 closes above 2699.39 that hold on the next pullback, then a close above 2716.01/2727.22, would put price above the H4 range midpoint and favor 2786.81-2804.59.
Bear shift: a close below 2682.01 followed by a close below 2660.49 (M15 bar 104 low) breaks the higher-low sequence and turns the tight range into a bear flag, opening 2641.37 then 2633.31.
Continued overlap between 2682.01 and 2699.39 keeps the market in breakout mode and makes any breakout a scalp-only environment.
A close back below 2633.31 would confirm the H4 range breaking down toward the 2486.12 higher low, invalidating the bull-trend pullback read.

market_context.summary: D1 bull-trend/channel with always_in long but a two-bar pullback back under 2680-2700; H4 labelled bull-trend/range with price in the lower third of the post-spike range 2633.31-2804.59 and lower highs 2804.59/2786.81/2699.39; H1 and M15 both rotating in tight, overlapping bands at the decision time.

D1.key_levels: 2850 high, 2641.37 pullback low, 2680 range top reclaimed/ lost, 2357.18 range low

H1.key_levels: 2850 spike high (bar 1789981200000), 2641.37 low (bar 1790179200000), last three bars close 2686.66/2684.97/2683.99 with lower highs

setup.type: range_middle_no_trigger

evidence_for: M15 bars 108-119 (open_time 1790279100000 to 1790289900000) all overlap inside 2676.02 (bar 118, open_time 1790288100000, low 2676.02) and 2699.39 (bar 108, open_time 1790279100000, high 2699.39): a ~23-point (~0.9%) band, and the final bar 119 (open 2678.64, high 2683.99, low 2678.64, close 2683.99, range 5.35) has broken nothing, so no trigger is present and no pending stop sits outside the cluster.

Resistance is immediately overhead: M15 high 2699.39 (bar 108) equals the earlier M15 high 2698.06 (bar 60, open_time 1790235900000, high 2698.06), a double top, with H4 lower highs 2786.81 and 2804.59 above, so a long at 2684 would be buying into structure ~15 points away.

Location is poor on both sides: 2683.99 is inside the middle of the 2676.02-2699.39 cluster and in the lower third of the H4 post-spike range 2633.31-2804.59 (mid ~2718.95), so a long is mid-cluster into resistance while a short is selling the lower half of a bull-trend H4 window right after a bull bar.

Recent M15 energy is mixed-to-bear into the cluster: bars 62-70 (open_time 1790237700000 to 1790244900000) printed nine consecutive lower closes from 2669.4 to 2638.94 with a spike down to 2633.31 (bar 71 low), while the recovery to 2699.39 is built of overlapping small-range bars, i.e. a channel-like drift rather than a strong bull leg.

H1 bars 117-119 (open_time 1790280000000, 1790283600000, 1790287200000) close 2686.66, 2684.97, 2683.99 with lower highs 2695.78, 2691.52, 2686.98: a three-bar lower-high drift, not a bull breakout or a strong reversal bar sequence.
evidence_against: Strongest opposing case (bull-flag long): both supplied contexts carry directional_pressure bull with always_in long (D1 bull-trend/channel, H4 bull-trend), and the H4 pullback low 2633.31 held far above the prior higher low 2486.12, so a bull-flag resolution is not excluded.

M15 bar 119 is a bull bar with no lower tail (open = low 2678.64, close = high 2683.99) after a ~53% retrace to 2676.02 of the 2655.22-2699.39 leg, which can be read as a usable bull signal bar; a buy stop above 2683.99 with invalidation at its low 2678.64 risks about 5.35 against roughly 15 points of open structure to the 2699.39 range top.

H4 bars 1790251200000 (close 2682.25) and 1790265600000 (close 2694.09) closed in the upper third of their ranges after testing 2640 and 2660.49, so the higher-timeframe pullback is still holding above its breakout base rather than breaking down.
uncertainty: The 2676.02-2699.39 M15 cluster is unresolved at the frozen time; the packet ends mid-cluster, so no breakout in either direction has been tested.

H4 fits both a bull flag (2633.31 holding above the 2486.12 higher low) and a post-spike trading range (roughly flat 20-bar net change, price below the range mid), and the ~60% pullback depth is the main bull-flag warning.
H1/M15 short-term drift is mildly lower while D1 remains a bull channel, a timeframe tension that lowers conviction in either direction at this location.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2699.39, then above 2716.01, with follow-through would make a breakout-pullback long actionable.
An M15 close below 2676.02 and then below 2655.22 would shift the near-term read to a range breakdown and support a short setup.

setup.type: tight trading range - no actionable setup at either edge

evidence_for: Tight trading range: M15 bars 107-119 (open_time 1790304300000 through 1790315100000) all overlap inside 2671.21 (bar 113 low) and 2684.26 (bar 107 high), a 13.05-point band, and every close of those 13 bars stays inside it; Brooks' handling of a tight trading range is to stand aside rather than pick a side in its middle.

Location is mid-band: the last close 2679.78 (M15 bar 119) sits inside the 2671.21-2684.26 band and about 70% up the broader 2633.31-2699.53 M15 range, immediately under the 2699.53 shelf (M15 bar 105, open_time 1790302500000, high 2699.53).

Decision bar gives no signal: M15 bar 119 (open 2680.46, high 2681.19, low 2679.78, close 2679.78) is a 1.41-point bar closing at its low, and M15 bar 118 (open 2677.58, high 2683.47, close 2680.46) failed to exceed bar 114's high 2683.74 - neither is an actionable trigger.

The upside is repeatedly capped: H1 bar 116 (open_time 1790301600000, open 2688.01, high 2699.53, low 2674.11, close 2674.11) closed at its low after tapping 2699.53, and H4 records highs 2695.84, 2698.06, 2699.39 and 2699.53 all failing to close above the 2700.00 prints of 1789804800000/1789948800000, so a long breakout here transacts straight into proven supply; a short below 2671.21 instead fades rising M15 lows.
evidence_against: Higher timeframes lean long and cut against standing aside: D1 context (current) is bull-trend with phase breakout-spike and always_in long, and H4 (current) records higher swing lows 2370.54, 2568.16, 2633.31, so pullbacks in this structure have repeatedly been bought.

M15 lows are still rising off the 2633.31 base: bar 113 low 2671.21, bar 114 low 2674.12, bar 116 low 2676.30, bar 118 low 2675.96, with the close 2679.78 holding about 46 points above the M15 bar 42 low 2633.31.

An upside resolution is not excluded: a buy stop above M15 bar 114 high 2683.74 (open_time 1790310600000, high 2683.74, close 2682.56) remains untriggered by bars 115-119 (highest subsequent high 2683.47), and H4 notes 8 of 9 closes in the upper half of its last 9 bars, a marginal bull always-in inside the range.
uncertainty: Whether the 13-bar M15 tight range resolves upward through the 2699.53/2700 shelf or downward through 2671.21 and then 2633.31 is not determinable from the closed bars supplied at decision_time_ms.

The supplied contexts disagree on phase: D1 labels the structure breakout-spike bull while H4 labels the same area 'range' with balanced directional pressure, so the higher-timeframe pull is real but not decisive.
No M15 bar has closed outside 2671.21-2684.26 for 13 bars, so any trigger a trader drafts is an untested pending stop rather than an observed break.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2699.53 with the following bar closing higher would make an upside breakout of the tight range tradable rather than mid-range exposure.
An M15 close below 2671.21 followed by a close below 2633.31 would confirm the failed 2700 tests as a bear resolution and shift the read toward the H4 2568.16-2570.00 shelf.

A wide-range M15 trend bar closing on its extreme out of the 2671.21-2684.26 band, plus one overlapping bar of follow-through, would convert the tight-range read into a breakout read in that direction.
A close back below 2674.12 that also ends the rising-low sequence (2671.21, 2674.12, 2676.30, 2675.96) would remove the marginal bull always-in inside the range.
